demo-expo-workflows.name: Expo workflow inspection
demo-expo-workflows.description: Read Expo EAS workflow runs with a robot-user access token for the intended account.

demo-expo-workflow-dispatch.name: Expo workflow dispatch (optional)
demo-expo-workflow-dispatch.description: Dispatch explicitly requested EAS workflows with a robot-user token. Add only for an authorized workflow; dispatch may start build or release jobs.

demo-vercel-inspection.name: Vercel inspection
demo-vercel-inspection.description: Read Vercel projects, deployments and build logs with a token scoped to the intended team or project.

demo-vercel-deployments.name: Vercel deployments (optional)
demo-vercel-deployments.description: Create explicitly requested deployments with a scoped token. Add only for an authorized deployment workflow; this connection permits writes.

demo-sentry-issues.name: Sentry issue reads
demo-sentry-issues.description: Choose shared read coverage at the API root with event:read and project:read, or narrow to the intended organization's issue prefix with event:read. Use an internal integration token on the confirmed API host and choose the intended Cengrid organisation or team audience.

demo-sentry-project.name: Sentry project reads
demo-sentry-project.description: Optional project connection for narrow coverage: set the intended project's prefix on the confirmed API host and use an internal integration token with project:read. The shared API-root connection can cover these reads; choose the intended Cengrid organisation or team audience.
